title: Battle of Austerlitz
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Austerlitz", at revision 1378712638, opens: "The Battle of Austerlitz was fought on Monday 2 December 1805, near Austerlitz, being the decisive engagement of the War of the Third Coalition. The Grande Armée under the command of Emperor Napoleon I defeated a combined Russo-Austrian army. One force was an imperial Russian army under the command of Tsar Alexander I and General Mikhail Kutuzov, while the other comprised an imperial Austrian army under the command of Emperor Francis II. The battle was known contemporaneously as the Battle of the Three Emperors." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q134114, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1805 battle during the War of the Third Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
